summary: Frostbolt build with Fingers of Frost and Shatter. Its 28 Arcane points take Arcane Mind, Arcane Instability and Arcane Blast for spell damage.
rotation: Cooldowns (Demonic Rune, racial) on a free GCD
Ice Lance on a Fingers of Frost charge when its 8s cooldown is up. The boss counts as Frozen, so it does 3 times the damage and gets Shatter's crit.
Arcane Blast to 3 stacks every 15s for 45% of Intellect as spell damage
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc
Ice Lance instead when a Frostbolt would not land before the end (its cast plus 1s)
Wand when nothing else can be cast (out of mana)
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Greater Frost (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Ice Lance's spell power coefficient is 0.429, the Season of Discovery value. The client has 0.
Frostbolt X's base damage is ×1.04 the client's value.
Winter's Chill only comes from Cone of Cold, so the build skips it.
Assumed: raid bosses can't be frozen. When Fingers of Frost charges apply is unknown.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Fireball stops at rank XI, Frostbolt at X and Arcane Missiles at VII. The books would add 50 DPS to Frost, 30 to Arcane, 17 to Fire and 0 to Frostfire.
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_frost unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Greater Frost) as a mage option, as the preset does. Its rotation casts Ice Lance on a Fingers of Frost charge whenever the cooldown allows.
